draft.title: Showcase v0

events.question: Will Ethereum fill at least 75% of a block?
events.yesRule: YES if gasUsed * 4 >= gasLimit * 3 in the selected finalized Ethereum mainnet block.
events.noRule: NO if the selected finalized block is available and the YES condition is false. Missing, conflicting or unfinalized data is not NO.

source.selectionRule: Select the first Ethereum mainnet execution block with timestamp >= 1790365680; its immediate parent must have timestamp < 1790365680. Read gasUsed, gasLimit, transaction count, baseFeePerGas and blobGasUsed from that block; compare fees with its parent.
source.finalityRule: PublicNode (https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com) and dRPC (https://eth.drpc.org) must both report the selected block as finalized and agree on its hash, parent and measured fields. RPC reports are evidence, not a cryptographic finality proof. The bonded assertion and challenge process decides the final outcome.
source.revisionRule: Archive the first corroborated observation. Conflicting later data requires a challenge, never silent evidence replacement. Missing or unfinalized evidence leaves the assertion unset; fixed contract deadlines and VOID rules apply.

Will Monad mainnet record at least 4,500 transactions across every 25th block from the first block at or after 08:45 UTC to the first block at or after 09:15 UTC on 30 September 2026, read from the public Monad RPC between 09:20 and 09:32 UTC?

Will the USGS earthquake catalogue, first captured between 09:00 and 09:12 UTC, list at least 2 earthquakes of magnitude 2.5 or more worldwide with origin times from 07:30 to 08:30 UTC on 30 September 2026?

Will the EMSC earthquake catalogue, first captured between 09:05 and 09:17 UTC, list at least 5 earthquakes of magnitude 3.0 or more worldwide with origin times from 07:30 to 08:30 UTC on 30 September 2026?
